title: Marvelous Designer Discord Contests Are Back: Introducing the Marvelous Winter Market
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/c3ccfa2c78974a988e8f2ea56ecd5fde/images/81e29614506f4313b361ad928835f1abMarvelous%20Winter%20Market%20%281%29.png)  
![9920b9e62c294de4888adf8a479495d7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/c3ccfa2c78974a988e8f2ea56ecd5fde/images/9920b9e62c294de4888adf8a479495d7Marvelous%20Winter%20Market%20%281%29.png)

We’re excited to bring back Marvelous Designer Discord contests with a brand-new creative challenge: ❄️Marvelous Winter Market❄️

Design winter market looks and scenes. You can focus on characters and their garments (vendor, guard, performer, shoppers) and/or environments (stalls, tents, signs, bags). The finished artwork can range from one highly detailed 3D model, to a scene in a shop, to a bird’s eye view of a bustling market. Be creative with your interpretation of “winter market”. It doesn’t need to be holiday themed, but it can be.

**Prizes**

🥇 First Place: 12 months of FREE Marvelous Designer and a feature on our social media  
🥈 Second Place: 6 months of FREE Marvelous Designer  
🥉 Third Place: 3 months of FREE Marvelous Designer

**Dates**

Begin creating now! Submissions will open January 16th and close January 30th.

**How To Enter**

To enter, just join the official Marvelous Designer Discord server. Come for the contest, stay for the community!

  
[**[Join the official Marvelous Designer Discord Server]**](https://discord.com/invite/pPEmF86DHc)
content_description: Join the Marvelous Designer Discord community to showcase your creativity in the Marvelous Winter Market contest for a chance to win free software and be featured on our social media.

title: [Notice] Temporary Review Delays During Year-End Holidays
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/bf13c997f99e4519b65b00fac13c5948/images/27bec5885b8f438b9355a7a6f18a6335CONNECT%20Emblem%20Square%28B%29%20Primary_RESIZE.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/bf13c997f99e4519b65b00fac13c5948/images/5ed8c9a5f10a4871823af8035cb931cbCONNECT%20Emblem%20Square%28B%29%20Primary.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/bf13c997f99e4519b65b00fac13c5948/images/beced90f9fab4118af2438927683614dCONNECT%20BI%20Plain.png)Hello,  
This is the CONNECT Team.

  


Due to year-end holidays and internal schedule adjustments,  
please note that paid item reviews may experience temporary delays starting December 19 (Thu).

  


Reviews will continue to be processed in the order they are received; however, processing times may vary depending on the item category, and overall review times may be longer than usual during this period.

  


Regular review operations are expected to resume in early January,  
after which we will return to our normal review schedule and continue to ensure a stable and efficient review process.

  


Thank you for your continued support of CONNECT throughout the year.💗

We wish you a warm and pleasant holiday season.🧑‍🎄🎄

  


Best regards,

CONNECT Team

  
![2e1ee9c26ece417d96a2be1d6797ce25](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/bf13c997f99e4519b65b00fac13c5948/images/2e1ee9c26ece417d96a2be1d6797ce25CONNECT%20Emblem%20Square%28B%29%20Primary_RESIZE.png)
content_description: This page informs users about temporary delays in paid item reviews during the year-end holiday period and assures the resumption of normal processing in early January.
